items.title: 27.5.3 Genetic code aur protein synthesis (protein banna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the genetic code and protein synthesis with Quick Check 27.4 answered (PDF 174).

blocks.text: Protein synthesis (protein banna) aik complex (pecheeda) process hai jis mein DNA mein code ki hui genetic information aage transfer (muntaqil) hoti hai. Jaandaron mein bohat se proteins banane ke liye do processes zaroori hain: transcription aur translation. Process replication se shuru hota hai, yani nucleus mein DNA ki copies banti hain. Phir protein banane ki genetic instructions (hidayaat) DNA ke gene se mRNA mein copy hoti hain; is process ko transcription kehte hain. Jab mRNA ka strand (dhaaga) mukammal ho jaye to woh DNA se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai aur ribosomes se jur jata hai. Ribosomes par mRNA ka code parha jata hai aur amino acids ki aik khaas sequence (tarteeb) mein badla jata hai; is tarah protein banne ke process ko translation kehte hain. Amino acids RNA ke bases ki sequence ke mutabiq lagte hain. tRNA molecules apne amino acids chhorte hain jo aapas mein jur kar chain, yani polypeptide chain, banate hain. Amino acids ke darmiyan bonds bante jate hain, chain lambi hoti jati hai, aur aakhir mein poora protein molecule ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche: DNA se wapas DNA tak ghoomta teer, replication (DNA se DNA), DNA polymerase; DNA (do dhaage); teer transcription (DNA se RNA), RNA polymerase; RNA (aik strand); teer translation (RNA se protein), ribosome; aur beads (motiyon) ki lari ki shakal mein protein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Replication ka ghoomta teer DNA se wapas DNA par aata hai: DNA ki copy. Transcription nucleus mein DNA se RNA banati hai, aur translation cytoplasm mein ribosomes par RNA ke code se amino acids ki lari (protein) banati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Sugar-phosphate backbone aur dono chains ke darmiyan base pairing se milne wali stability (mazbooti) ka comparison (muqabla) karein. Bonds ki qism aur Adenine (A)–Thymine (T) aur Guanine (G)–Cytosine (C) ke darmiyan bonds ki tadaad batayein.
blocks.explanation: Backbone mazboot covalent phosphodiester bonds se jura hai, is liye har dhaaga bohat mazboot hai. Dono dhaage sirf bases ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se jure hain: A–T jore mein do aur G–C jore mein teen. Har hydrogen bond kamzor hai, is liye dhaage replication ke liye alag ho sakte hain, lekin lakhon bonds mil kar double helix ko mazbooti se thaamte hain; G–C zyada hon to hissa zyada mazboot hota hai.

rows: Do strands ke darmiyan, bases ke beech
Har strand ko bohat mazboot banata hai; aasani se nahi toot'ta
A–T pair mein 2 aur G–C pair mein 3 hydrogen bonds
Replication ke liye strands alag ho sakte hain; lakhon bonds mil kar double helix ko thaamte hain; G–C zyada hon to zyada stable

blocks.prompt: b) DNA aur RNA chemically kaise mukhtalif hain? Dono mein kya baatein milti hain?
blocks.explanation: Farq (differences): DNA mein deoxyribose sugar aur thymine hai aur yeh double stranded (do dhaagon wala) hai; RNA mein ribose aur uracil hai aur yeh aam taur par single stranded hai. Similarities (mushabehat): dono nucleotides (phosphate, paanch carbon wali sugar, base) ke polymers hain jo phosphodiester links se jure hain, aur dono mein A, G aur C bases hain.

rows: Similarity: nucleotides ka polymer, phosphodiester links
Similarity: nucleotides ka polymer, phosphodiester links

blocks.prompt: c) Insani jism ke taqreeban har cell mein bilkul wahi 23 jore chromosomes hain, phir bhi laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin banata hai aur jild ka cell keratin. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Har qism ka cell mukhtalif genes switch on (chalu) karta hai: banne wala laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin ka gene transcribe karta hai, aur jild ka cell keratin ka gene; baqi genes band rehte hain.

items: Replication: DNA ki copy; transcription: nucleus mein DNA se mRNA.
Translation: ribosomes par mRNA ka code parh kar tRNA amino acids ko protein mein jorte hain.
